_comment: AC4 corpus for tests/test_case_fold_sweep.py. Each row is run through the real no_human.agent.guard.evaluate() entry point (Bash, forbidden_paths=[], never_push_to=['main']). `baseline` records denied-ness (true=denied, false=allowed) measured on the pre-fix tree (src/no_human/agent/exec_names.py and venv_install_guard.py restored to their parent-commit content via `git show HEAD:<path>`, since this dev sandbox's destructive-op guard blocks `git worktree add`). On this single-volume dev host the bare rows below happen to answer identically pre- and post-fix (the OLD __file__-based probe and the NEW cwd/PATH-union probe both measure the same underlying APFS volume), so this file's job is the AC4 safety net (zero DENY->ALLOW) rather than the closing-direction proof; the closing-direction proof (PIP/Pip/PIP3/UV installer rows flipping ALLOW->DENY) lives in test_the_sweep_moved_rows_in_the_closing_direction, which needs a constructed two-venv session to exercise structurally and is therefore not representable as static cwd/env literals here.
